violation_type.title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk (26 TAC §747.305(b)(4))
violation_type.short_title: Parental Communication - Situation that Placed a Child at Risk
violation_type.typical_finding: During the investigation, it was found that a child's parents were not informed of a situation that occurred that placed the child at risk.

finding_variants.text: During the investigation, it was found that a child's parents were not informed of a situation that occurred that placed the child at risk.

Interviews were conducted and procedures were evaluated. It was determined that a the parent of an infant child was not notified of an incident that occurred while the child was in care at the childcare home.

Based on the information found during the DFPS investigation, a parent was not immediately notified of a situation placing their child at risk. The mother was not contacted until 12:04pm yet the child was allegedly found before 11:00am

The director/primary caregiver failed to immediately notify the child's parent of an incident that placed the child at risk when the child exited the facility unsupervised and was subsequently returned by a neighbor.
